7	
8	def commission(revenue: Decimal) -> Decimal:
9	    first_tier = min(revenue, Decimal("100000"))
10	    second_tier = min(max(revenue - Decimal("100000"), Decimal("0")), Decimal("200000"))
11	    third_tier = max(revenue - Decimal("300000"), Decimal("0"))
12	    return (
13	        first_tier * Decimal("0.20")
14	        + second_tier * Decimal("0.15")

16	    ).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
17	
18	
19	def main() -> int:
